_comment: Maps every reported figure and table to the exact thing that produced it. Required by section 6 of the validation protocol. One entry per reported result; never edit a past entry.

_schema.id: figure or table identifier as it appears in the paper
_schema.script: path to the script that generated it
_schema.config: path to the config file used
_schema.commit: git commit hash at time of run
_schema.seed: integer seed, or list of seeds
_schema.output: path to the data file holding the numbers
_schema.predictions: PREDICTIONS.md entries this result bears on
